sources.title: squad: README.md
sources.locator: Install, initialize, launch and project team
sources.finding: One repository team can be initialized for seven host clients. Each client needs its own sign-in and model access.

sources.title: squad: LICENSE
sources.finding: MIT permits use of the scoped source without a license fee.

sources.title: squad: package.json
sources.finding: Pinned public source package metadata, not a claim that every HEAD feature is in a release.

sources.title: squad: CHANGELOG.md
sources.locator: 2.0.0 section dated 2026-11-18, especially seven hosts, experimental backend, Claude plugin and dashboard
sources.finding: The changelog distinguishes host projections, a Claude plugin and member subagents, and an experimental execution backend. It documents a local transcript dashboard.

sources.title: squad: packages/squad-cli/README.md
sources.finding: Product CLI and terminal shell use a project squad and separately installed/authenticated coding client.

sources.title: squad: docs/src/content/docs/get-started/installation.md
sources.finding: Node CLI and standalone installation routes are documented for macOS, Windows and Linux.

sources.title: squad: docs/src/content/docs/scenarios/using-squad-across-clients.md
sources.locator: Lines 7-105, generated files and per-client activation
sources.finding: Client projections configure a product-supplied coordinator and host tools. Host authentication and MCP approvals are separate.

sources.title: squad: docs/src/content/docs/features/parallel-execution.md
sources.locator: Background versus sync mode; reviewer gates
sources.finding: Documents host-coordinator fan-out and result collection. Examples and stated defaults are documentary claims, not measured concurrency.

sources.title: squad: docs/src/content/docs/features/worktrees.md
sources.finding: Describes manually created Git worktrees and separate or shared team state. It does not by itself establish a native checkout allocator.

sources.title: squad: docs/src/content/docs/features/reviewer-protocol.md
sources.finding: Documents reviewer roles and host-agent review guidance. Prompt instructions do not establish a universal OS or merge authority gate.

sources.title: squad: docs/src/content/docs/scenarios/multi-machine-watch.md
sources.locator: Lines 7-75, opt-in work claims and host placement
sources.finding: Watchers can run on user machines/pods. Git-ref claims are optional and off by default; unconfigured watchers can duplicate work.

sources.title: squad: packages/squad-cli/src/cli/shell/index.ts
sources.finding: CLI creates a coordinator session and named member sessions, passes approve-once permissions and dispatches multi routes with Promise.allSettled in the shared team root.

sources.title: squad: packages/squad-cli/src/cli/shell/coordinator.ts
sources.finding: Product prompt and response parser supply routing decisions rather than merely displaying provider subagents.

sources.title: squad: packages/squad-cli/src/cli/shell/spawn.ts
sources.finding: A supplied client creates a real SDK session in teamRoot; without a client the helper returns a stub. The stub is not execution evidence.

sources.title: squad: packages/squad-cli/src/cli/commands/watch/config.ts
sources.locator: DEFAULTS lines 203-211 and execute flags lines 281-290
sources.finding: Execute is off by default, maxConcurrent is one and timeout is 30 minutes. Execute presets may bypass host permission prompts.

sources.title: squad: packages/squad-cli/src/cli/core/backend-mcp.ts
sources.finding: Experimental local backend needs explicit enablement and a registered execution harness. A backend URL alone is not a shipped remote server.

sources.title: squad: packages/squad-sdk/src/runtime/telemetry.ts
sources.locator: TelemetryCollector defaults, setConsent, flush and default transport
sources.finding: SDK collector defaults disabled with an empty endpoint and no-op transport. setConsent and pluggable transports are SDK APIs, not proof of an app-wide privacy switch.

sources.title: squad: packages/squad-sdk/src/runtime/otel-init.ts
sources.finding: CLI can initialize OTel and bridge events. Endpoint configuration is separate from the collector consent flag.

sources.title: squad: packages/squad-sdk/src/runtime/otel.ts
sources.finding: OTLP export is configured through an endpoint/options; this bounded inspection does not establish an app-wide absence of vendor telemetry.
